# Welcome to fed-edu Discussions

This is a friendly place to ask questions about the fed-edu GitHub Organization Onboarding guide, suggest documentation improvements, and share useful onboarding feedback.

For personal account or invitation issues, use the [onboarding-help issue form](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/onboarding-help.md). Never post passwords, tokens, private invitation links, or private personal information.

Please be patient and respectful. Start with the [README](../README.md) and the [troubleshooting guide](../docs/04-troubleshooting.md).
